questions.question: Did more female Medicare beneficiaries die in 2023 than male Medicare beneficiaries?
questions.program:

female_val = int(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Female'].iloc[0, 1])
result = 'yes' if female_val > male_val else 'no'

questions.question: In calendar year 2023, which month recorded the highest number of deaths across all Medicare beneficiaries?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_deaths_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR ENROLL AB 33_CPS_02ENR', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year'].iloc[0]
row_2023 = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '2023'].iloc[0]

months = header_row.iloc[2:].values
values = pd.to_numeric(row_2023.iloc[2:], errors='coerce').values

max_idx = values.argmax()
result = str(months[max_idx]).strip()

questions.question: What are the three states with the highest total number of Medicare deaths in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_deaths_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR ENROLL AB 35_CPS_02ENR', header=None)
# State rows run from Alabama (index 8) to Wyoming (index 58)
# Find index of Alabama and Wyoming
start_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Alabama'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Wyoming'].index[0]
states_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx+1].copy()
states_df[1] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[1], errors='coerce')
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=1, ascending=False).head(3)
result = [str(x).strip() for x in top3[0].tolist()]
